name: Perplexing Shot
description: Fires an erratic bolt at an enemy within %cast_range% tiles for %damage% damage, ricocheting up to %bounces% times and striking %bonus_damage% harder with every jump.
details: Each jump goes to a random unit beside the last victim - friend or foe alike.
It never hits the same unit twice, and fizzles out if there is nothing beside it to jump to.

upgrade.summary: Ricochets up to %bounces% times, if the board can carry it that far.
